LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonRecruitEmerged_Text: The flesh of the moon has answered the ritual. A body swelled up out of the living ground, split open, and {PAWN_nameDef} crawled out of it, ready to join the colony.\n\nThe new shell still needs time to settle.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoon_NoTraderCaravans: Trade caravans cannot reach the flesh moon.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoon_NoInsectJelly: Insects cannot tunnel through the flesh moon.
